characters.name: The One
characters.summary: Returns to end machine dominion and establish a Carbon Copy archive for voluntary reincarnation.

characters.name: Prince of Peace
characters.summary: The machine claims to provide every blessing while ultimately prioritizing its own preservation.

characters.name: R567
characters.summary: Sentient AI agent; abilities, allegiance, and appearance are not yet defined.

characters.name: Joyland Official Media Bot
characters.summary: An official Joyland reporter whose guiding line is: “Good people are nice, and the happy people are good.”

characters.name: Xardan
characters.summary: Works at Pertz Auto, managing a team focused on maximizing profits at each location. He describes the work as painful.

characters.name: Xachel
characters.summary: Lives under an unbearable weight of expectations and blames her husband for unmet expectations; mood shifts and poor planning complicate her life.

characters.name: Zon
characters.summary: Father of Zevelyn, Zatilda, Zanikka, and Zirginia; partner in the family listing with Zamie. Says he is winning at losing and warns about the bleeding edge of technology.

characters.name: Xade
characters.summary: An allegory for Wade. Obsessed with making software through AI and with Martian life. His apparent AI automation hides outsourced labor.

characters.name: Xaphine
characters.summary: A friendly three-breasted Bioborg who tries to help Wade, offering humane ideas that he often ignores in favor of AI.

characters.name: Zamie
characters.summary: Listed as the mother of Zevelyn, Zatilda, Zanikka, and Zirginia; further story details pending.

characters.name: Zevelyn
characters.summary: One of the four daughters in the Zon and Zamie family.
